title: Evaluate package dependency change evidence
summary: Deterministically classify a package dependency change and evaluate explicit installed-target, public-surface, lockfile, and consumer-check evidence before deriving a land, blocked, or revert disposition.

operations.title: Inspect dependency change
operations.description: Classify the before and after package specifications and report whether the requested dependency source or version constraint changed.

operations.title: Verify installed target
operations.description: Evaluate explicit package-presence and resolved-version evidence against the requested registry specification. Non-registry specifications remain unverified rather than being guessed.

operations.title: Verify required package surface
operations.description: Compare explicit required public paths with the package paths observed by the caller and return the deterministic missing set.

operations.title: Verify lockfile alignment
operations.description: Check that the root dependency specification and locked version both align with the requested registry specification.

operations.title: Assess consumer check evidence
operations.description: Map an explicitly identified consumer check outcome to verified, failed, or unverified without inferring that any command ran.

operations.title: Evaluate dependency disposition
operations.description: Derive stable ordered blockers and return land only when a real change and all required evidence are verified; otherwise block a proposal or revert an applied change.
